description: Move the person's progress bar during a long step or a task without steps: percent, or current and total (e.g. 12 of 40 files), plus a short message about what's happening now. On a task with steps, the steps drive the bar: numbers you send for the task go to its running step. Call at milestones, every few minutes at most. Returns the task's progress bar and, on a task with steps, which step your numbers went to. Fails without percent, total or message, on an unknown task_id, or past the per-minute limit (the error says when to retry).

current.description: Items done so far, with total

message.description: What is happening now, e.g. "Running the test suite"

task_id.description: The ID of the task you are reporting on (a step, or a task without steps)

name: taskhold_progress
title: Report progress
